newsitem.title: USA: Ford Credit makes executive VP changes.
newsitem.headline: Ford Credit makes executive VP changes.

text.p: Ford Credit, a wholly owned unit of Ford Motor Co, said Monday it will make various executive changes effective June 1.

Jack Clissold was assigned to the newly created position of executive vice president - diversified and corporate operations. He will oversee Ford Credit's growth beyond its traditional market of Ford dealers and their customers, the company said.
Greg Smith replaces Clissold as executive vice president, North American Financing Operations, including commercial lending and insurance services.
David Flanigan replaces Smith as executive vice president - International Financing Operations.
Michael Bannister, who previously served as executive director of Ford Credit European Sales Operations and Worldwide Trade Financing, will take Flanigan's place as chairman of Ford Credit Europe.
Ford Credit provides automotive financial services in 33 countries to more than eight million customers through 11,400 dealers.
